inference: legacy 16 kHz / 40-bin Fbank and released global CMVN
exact CRDNN, location-aware GRU decoder, and two-layer RNNLM graph
80-beam shallow-fusion decoding with attention-shift, EOS, and coverage constraints
strict Safetensors conversion and portable reload
training: CTC plus sequence loss for the first five epochs, then sequence loss
published Adadelta and NewBob recipe metadata
limitations: The released model is English-only despite the provider family's generic name.
The encoder is bidirectional and does not provide causally correct streaming.
The public recipe depends on OpenRIR noise and speed perturbation; VoiceHub exposes those as dataset transforms rather than hidden model-side downloads.
No corpus-level benchmark or accuracy improvement over the 3.09 WER model-card result is claimed.

security_boundary.source_format: three pickle checkpoints plus a protobuf SentencePiece model
security_boundary.conversion: Explicit trust_pickle_checkpoint=True, torch.load(weights_only=True), pinned SHA-256, and complete namespace/shape/fingerprint validation.
security_boundary.runtime_format: Safetensors plus the bounded original tokenizer.model bytes
security_boundary.runtime_dependencies: PyTorch, the Python standard library, and VoiceHub only
